title: Pokemon Glazed Unofficial (v9.1.0)
sources: The ROM itself (Pokemon Glazed Unofficial (v9.1.0)): region map section names (each place resolves to a section with maps) and trainer names, teams and levels, read on the PC with throwaway tools
Glazed fan wiki (fanmadepokemonglazed.fandom.com): Tunod, Johto, Rankor, gym, league and legendary pages, read through search-engine extracts (the wiki blocks direct reads)
nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed and nuzlocked.vercel.app/guides/glazed: encounter order, rival and gym list
PokéHarbor (pokeharbor.com ?p=1815, ?p=55306), PokeHostel, emulatorhacks.com (Glazed, Golden Glazed and Blazed Glazed change lists), The RPG Spotlight review (2020)
nuzlocked.vercel.app/guides/glazed: the boss list in order (rivals, Team Fusion/Alpha, mini bosses: Cameron, Lucbui, the Cianwood Dojo, Wattson, Will, PokéFan X)

vizzed.com boards: 'Glazed Guide' (Livid Pain, beta 5, 2014) and 'Legends of Glazed' (beta 6) - older betas, used for story order, HMs, gifts, trades and legendaries where nothing newer says otherwise
emulatorhacks.com (Pokemon Glazed GBA page): the 9.0 and 9.1 change lists and the legendary table
PokéCommunity Blazed Glazed thread and YouTube comments: where Trade Stones come from (Northcoast ski race, Goldenrod store)
The ROM itself (Glazed 9.2.0 as the companion reads it): hidden items from the map events, evolution methods (items, friendship) and the Trainer Isle / rematch teams
No 9.2.0 changelog was found; facts that may differ are taken from the 9.2.0 ROM dump

milestones.name: Rival: Percy (Forest Pass)
milestones.tips: Percy, a boy with a Cyndaquil, battles you with Cyndaquil (Lv 5). Any of the five starters wins with a level or two on it; heal in Glenwood first.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Oceanview City)
milestones.tips: Chelle (Chikorita) at the Oceanview power plant: Chikorita, Pikachu (Lv 12-14). The red-scarfed Pikachu you met in Forest Pass is fought again here.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 1: Sparky
milestones.badge_note: Jolt Badge: Cut in the field (the wiki's list).
milestones.tips: Electric types: Shinx, Flaaffy, Jolteon (Lv 13-15). Ground types shut them out; Riolu's Fighting moves and Turtwig's Grass moves also hold. Shinx is the only Electric starter that struggles.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Team Fusion: Michael at Haunted Rock
milestones.tips: Michael, Team Fusion's head, sends out a single Zoroark (Lv 25). Zoroark is Dark: Fighting and Bug moves hit it hard.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 2: Terry
milestones.tips: Ground types: Gligar, Vibrava, Phanpy (Lv 23-27). Water and Grass moves work; Gligar and Vibrava ignore Ground moves, so bring Ice or Water for them.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Seaspray Town)
milestones.tips: Chelle again: Bayleef, Raichu (Lv 25-27). Fire, Flying and Ice moves cover Bayleef.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 3: Flo
milestones.badge_note: Crest Badge: Rock Smash (wiki); gym TM03 Water Pulse.
milestones.tips: Water types: Wartortle, Seadra, Milotic, Kingdra (Lv 29-31). Grass and Electric moves; Kingdra takes neutral damage from both, so hit it hard and fast.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Percy (Geminite Village)
milestones.tips: Percy: Quilava, Kirlia, Electrike (Lv 25-30).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Rival: masked trainer (Seaspray Town Gym)
milestones.tips: Cato's first fight, at the Seaspray gym; the ROM names him '???' here: Houndour 28, Croconaw 30, Porygon 28. Electric or Grass moves for Croconaw, Water or Ground for Houndour.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Cato at Seaspray Town Gym)

milestones.name: Rival: Percy (Northcoast Town)
milestones.tips: Percy at the Northcoast gym: Gardevoir, Quilava, Manectric (Lv 32-33).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 4: Lief
milestones.badge_note: Stem Badge: Strength (wiki); gym TM22 Solar Beam.
milestones.tips: Grass types: Jumpluff, Tangrowth, Leafeon, Venusaur (Lv 33-34). Fire, Flying and Ice moves; Venusaur is part Poison, so Psychic works on it too.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Tunod Safari Zone)
milestones.tips: Chelle: Raichu, Meganium, Parasect, Breloom (Lv 31-34).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Rival: Cato (Southerly City)
milestones.tips: Cato (Feraligatr) fights you in Southerly City: Houndoom, Feraligatr, Porygon2, Espeon (Lv 31-35). Electric and Grass moves on Feraligatr; Fighting on Houndoom and Porygon2.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Cato: Seaspray Town Gym, then Southerly City)

milestones.name: Team Fusion: Henri (Trainer Isle)
milestones.tips: Henri's pair of Water types: Huntail and Gorebyss (Lv 34). Electric and Grass moves end it quickly.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Henri, Trainer Isle)

milestones.name: Team Fusion: Michael at Temporal Tower
milestones.tips: Michael again: Ditto, Zoroark (Lv 36-37). A Ditto copies your lead, so lead with something that isn't your strongest attacker.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 5: Irene
milestones.tips: Ice types: Snorunt, Glaceon, Froslass, Weavile (Lv 35-37). Fire, Fighting, Rock and Steel moves; Froslass is part Ghost, so keep a Dark or Ghost move for it.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 6: Ernest
milestones.tips: Fire types: Magmortar, Charizard, Typhlosion, Infernape, Blaziken (Lv 37-39), every Fire starter of the earlier games. Water, Ground and Rock moves; Blaziken and Infernape are part Fighting, so Psychic and Flying work on them.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Percy (Darkwood Town)
milestones.tips: Percy: Gardevoir, Manectric, Quilava, Scraggy, Seadra (Lv 39-41).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Team Fusion: Fusion Labs
milestones.tips: Team Fusion's lab in the Palmtree Resort: Regina (Zoroark, Ditto, Kecleon, Roserade (Lv 40-42)) and Michael with the three legends he has taken (Dialga, Palkia, Giratina (Lv 42)). Fairy and Dragon moves hurt Dialga, Palkia and Giratina.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 7: Nicole
milestones.badge_note: Core Badge: Dive (wiki); gym TM39 Rock Tomb.
milestones.tips: Rock types: Tyranitar, Rhyperior, Cradily, Shuckle, Aggron (Lv 40-42). Water and Grass moves do the most; Fighting and Ground hit most of them too. Shuckle walls: use special Water or Grass moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 8: Tyson
milestones.badge_note: Clobber Badge: Waterfall (wiki; one page puts Waterfall before this gym).
milestones.tips: Fighting types: Hitmonlee, Scrafty, Gallade, Lucario, Conkeldurr (Lv 43-46). Psychic, Flying and Fairy moves; Gallade is part Psychic (use Dark or Ghost), Lucario is part Steel (use Fire or Ground).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Path of Victory)
milestones.tips: Chelle on the way to the league: Raichu, Meganium, Breloom, Gabite, Parasect (Lv 42-44).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Mini boss: Lucbui (Path of Victory)
milestones.tips: Optional and over the league's levels: Quilava 55, Jolteon, Breloom, Porygon-Z, Manectric, Metagross (Lv 50). Ground moves hit three of them; come back later if needed.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (mini boss list)

milestones.name: Rival: Cato (Tunod League)
milestones.tips: Cato's last Tunod battles (Houndoom, Feraligatr, Porygon-Z, Espeon, Gabite (Lv 44-46), then Houndoom, Feraligatr, Porygon-Z, Espeon, Garchomp (Lv 50-53)) come between the eighth badge and the league; level to the low 50s.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (where: tracker; order by level)

milestones.name: Tunod Elite Four: Rosaline
milestones.tips: Colour-themed, not type-themed (pink): Lickilicky, Milotic, Slowking, Chansey, Blissey (Lv 46-48). Mostly Normal and Water bulk: Fighting moves and a strong Electric or Grass attacker.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Tunod Elite Four: Magnus
milestones.tips: Colour-themed, not type-themed (purple): Arbok, Gengar, Mienshao, Sableye, Drapion (Lv 47-49). Poison and Ghost: Psychic, Ground and Dark moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Tunod Elite Four: Tanya
milestones.tips: Colour-themed, not type-themed (orange): Floatzel, Shedinja, Infernape, Arcanine, Dragonite (Lv 49-52). Fire and Water with a Dragonite: Ice and Rock moves; Shedinja falls to any Fire, Rock, Flying, Ghost or Dark hit.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Tunod Elite Four: Gray
milestones.tips: Colour-themed, not type-themed (grey): Zoroark, Machamp, Mightyena, Aggron, Skarmory (Lv 51-53). Steel, Fighting and Dark: Fire, Ground and Fighting moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Tunod Champion: Blake
milestones.tips: Mostly Dark: Snorlax, Honchkrow, Weavile, Umbreon, Houndoom, Darkrai (Lv 53-57). Fighting, Bug and Fairy moves; Snorlax wants a strong Fighting move.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Mini boss: Cameron (Cameron's Dojo)
milestones.tips: An optional Fighting-heavy six at Lv 50: Gallade, Heracross, Breloom, Scrafty, Machamp, Infernape. Flying and Psychic moves. The old guide says the Darkwood dojo ends with a Blaziken for you.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (optional); vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain) (Darkwood dojo)

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Route 39)
milestones.tips: Johto starts at Route 39 after the Tunod league. Chelle: Raichu, Meganium, Breloom, Garchomp, Absol, Seadra (Lv 53-56).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 9: Falkner
milestones.badge_note: Zephyr Badge: Bounce in the field (wiki); gym TM40 Aerial Ace.
milestones.tips: Johto gym 1: Gliscor, Gyarados, Salamence, Pidgeot, Pidgeot (Lv 56-57). Electric, Ice and Rock moves; Gliscor takes four times from Ice.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 10: Morty
milestones.tips: Johto gym 2: Froslass, Sableye, Mismagius, Gengar, Gengar (Lv 60-62). Dark and Ghost moves; Sableye has one weakness (Fairy).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Kimono Girls (Ecruteak City)
milestones.tips: Five single-Pokemon fights, one Eevee form each: Umbreon, Espeon, Flareon, Jolteon, Vaporeon (Lv 60). The old guide calls them repeatable for money.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain) (repeatable, money)

milestones.name: Regina's coalition in Johto
milestones.tips: Regina, Team Fusion's boss, regroups in Johto; her fights in the ROM run Ditto, Zoroark, Kecleon, Miltank, Wobbuffet (Lv 52), then Zoroark, Ditto, Kecleon, Banette, Aggron (Lv 60-61). Ditto and Zoroark copy and disguise: watch what you attack.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts) (places: wiki list; order by level)

milestones.name: Gym 11: Jasmine
milestones.badge_note: Mineral Badge (her gym opens after the Church of Alpha events in Whitewood City, wiki).
milestones.tips: Johto gym 3: Aggron, Magnezone, Metagross, Scizor, Steelix (Lv 59-63). Fire, Fighting and Ground moves; Metagross and Scizor also fear Fire.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Church of Alpha: Sexton and Pius
milestones.tips: The Church of Alpha in Whitewood City: Sexton (Milotic, Gardevoir, Pidgeot (Lv 63)) and its leader Pius (Gallade, Absol, Noctowl (Lv 64)). Pius later frees Lugia.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 12: Bugsy
milestones.tips: Johto gym 4: Forretress, Pinsir, Yanmega, Armaldo, Scizor (Lv 64-66). Fire, Flying and Rock moves; Forretress and Scizor take four times from Fire.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 13: Simon
milestones.tips: Johto gym 5: Clefable, Mawile, Togekiss, Azumarill, Gardevoir (Lv 61-63). The wiki lists Normal, but his team in this ROM is Fairy types: Steel and Poison moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 14: Brian
milestones.badge_note: Psyche Badge; gym TM04 Calm Mind.
milestones.tips: Johto gym 6: Starmie, Espeon, Gardevoir, Alakazam, Gallade (Lv 65-68). Dark, Ghost and Bug moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Regina with Ho-Oh (Bell Tower)
milestones.tips: Regina on the Bell Tower roof: Ho-Oh, Zoroark, Absol (Lv 50-66). Ho-Oh is Fire/Flying: Rock moves hit it four times.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Gym 15: Silver
milestones.tips: Johto gym 7: Honchkrow, Weavile, Absol, Umbreon, Hydreigon (Lv 65-68). Fighting, Bug and Fairy moves; Hydreigon takes four times from Fairy.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Cianwood Dojo: the Tunod leaders
milestones.tips: The eight Tunod leaders wait in the Cianwood Dojo with full six-member teams at Lv 66-68 (Sparky's Jolteon, Terry's Donphan, Flo's Kingdra, Lief's Venusaur, Irene's Weavile, Ernest's Blaziken, Nicole's Aggron, Tyson's Conkeldurr lead the top level).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed and nuzlocked.vercel.app (Cianwood Dojo mini bosses)

milestones.name: Cianwood Dojo: Lucbui
milestones.tips: Lucbui again: Porygon-Z, Breloom, Aggron, Magnezone, Latias, Typhlosion (Lv 66-68). Ground moves cover Aggron, Magnezone and Typhlosion.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Lucbui, Cianwood Dojo)

milestones.name: Cianwood Dojo: Alexa
milestones.tips: Alexa: Alakazam, Nidoking, Espeon, Dragonite, Lucario, Swampert (Lv 67-69). Brant and Alexa are the default hero names; the ROM holds a matching Lv 69 Brant team too (Poliwrath, Nidoqueen, Umbreon, Dragonite, Zoroark, Blaziken).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Alexa, Cianwood); emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Evergreen Town)
milestones.tips: Chelle: Breloom, Meganium, Raichu, Garchomp, Absol, Kingdra (Lv 63-66).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Gym 16: Clair
milestones.tips: Johto gym 8: Garchomp, Druddigon, Salamence, Kingdra, Dragonite (Lv 69-72). Ice, Dragon and Fairy moves; Garchomp and Salamence take four times from Ice.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Rival: Cato (Ruins of Alph)
milestones.tips: Cato returns before the Johto league: Houndoom, Feraligatr, Porygon-Z, Espeon, Salamence, Hydreigon (Lv 68-71).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (order by level)

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Johto Victory Road)
milestones.tips: Chelle: Breloom, Meganium, Raichu, Garchomp, Absol, Kingdra (Lv 69-72).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Johto Elite Four: Ivan
milestones.tips: Muk, Tentacruel, Gengar, Crobat, Seviper (Lv 77-79). Psychic and Ground moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Johto Elite Four: Whitney
milestones.tips: Ambipom, Lickilicky, Kangaskhan, Blissey, Miltank (Lv 78-80). Fighting moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Johto Elite Four: Powell
milestones.tips: Raichu, Galvantula, Electivire, Jolteon, Ampharos (Lv 79-82). Ground moves; Galvantula also fears Fire and Rock.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Johto Elite Four: Eusine
milestones.tips: Gyarados, Starmie, Swampert, Milotic, Suicune (Lv 80-83). Grass and Electric moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rival: Cato (Johto League)
milestones.tips: Cato waits at the Johto league: Houndoom, Feraligatr, Porygon-Z, Espeon, Salamence, Hydreigon (Lv 77-79).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Johto Champion: Kris
milestones.tips: A mixed team: Heracross, Garchomp, Sceptile, Metagross, Arcanine, Feraligatr (Lv 82-85). Bring Fire for Heracross and Metagross, Ice for Garchomp and Sceptile.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Tunod League rematch: Elite Four
milestones.tips: The ROM holds a second Tunod league: Rosaline 77, Magnus 78, Tanya 79 and Gray 80 (Gray adds Registeel).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); PokéHarbor ?p=1815 (rematches with trainers and leaders)

milestones.name: Tunod League rematch: Champion Percy
milestones.tips: Percy took Blake's seat after your first win: Gardevoir, Manectric, Quilava 87, Scrafty, Kingdra, Steelix (Lv 80-87). Ground moves hit Manectric, Quilava and Steelix.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain) (Percy becomes the new champion)

milestones.name: Johto League rematch: Elite Four
milestones.tips: Six-member rematch teams: Ivan 95 (Poison), Whitney 96 (Normal), Powell 97 (Electric), Eusine 99 (Water, Suicune).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); PokéHarbor ?p=1815 (rematches)

milestones.name: Johto League rematch: Champion Kris
milestones.tips: Kris's same six, all at Lv 100: Heracross, Garchomp, Sceptile, Metagross, Arcanine, Feraligatr. Ice and Fire moves cover most of it.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); PokéHarbor ?p=1815 (rematches)

milestones.name: Rankor: Thor (Nitro Isle)
milestones.tips: The Rankor isles have four leaders who each punch your Rankor Ticket (no badges). Thor's logic-puzzle gym, Poison team: Crobat, Weezing, Gengar, Toxicroak, Nidoking and 1 more (Lv 78-82). Psychic and Ground moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Mini boss: Wattson (Nitro Isle)
milestones.tips: Wattson's Electric five: Electabuzz, Raichu, Electrode, Magnezone, Manectric (Lv 78). Ground moves; Magnezone also fears Fire and Fighting.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Wattson, Nitro Isle)

milestones.name: Rankor: Ricky (Kolo Isle)
milestones.tips: Dragon types: Salamence, Haxorus, Kingdra, Dragonite, Flygon and 1 more (Lv 80-82). Ice and Fairy moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Team Fusion: Regina (Mt. Frozon)
milestones.tips: Regina stops you as you go for Articuno: Zoroark, Absol, Ho-Oh, Moltres (Lv 80-81). Rock moves hit both birds hard; Fighting for Zoroark and Absol.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Regina, Mt. Frozon); Glazed fan wiki walkthrough (search extract)

milestones.name: Mini boss: PokéFan X (Mt. Frozon)
milestones.tips: 'Trainer X': Feraligatr, Drapion, Granbull, Porygon-Z, Pikachu, Arceus (Lv 82). Fighting moves are the broadest answer.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (PokéFan X, Mt. Frozon)

milestones.name: Mini boss: Gym Guardian Will (Alpha Isle)
milestones.tips: Will guards Sora's isle: Politoed, Gyarados, Galvantula, Zapdos, Empoleon (Lv 78). Electric moves hit four of the five.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Gym Guardian Will, Alpha Isle)

milestones.name: Rankor: Sora (Alpha Isle)
milestones.tips: Psychic types: Alakazam, Jirachi, Delphox, Slowking, Gallade, Gardevoir (Lv 81-84). Dark, Ghost and Bug moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Rankor: Makunouchi (Reign Isle)
milestones.tips: Fighting types: Blaziken, Conkeldurr, Infernape, Gliscor, Greninja, Machamp (Lv 85-87). Psychic, Flying and Fairy moves.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Alpha: Sexton (Peaks of Alpha)
milestones.tips: Sexton blocks the climb twice: Togekiss and Breloom (Lv 81), then a lone Lucario (Lv 83). Fire and Flying moves; Ground or Fighting for Lucario.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Alpha Sexton twice, Peaks of Alpha)

milestones.name: Alpha Leader Pius (Peaks of Alpha)
milestones.tips: Pius brings Lugia: Absol, Noctowl, Lucario, Lugia 83, Gallade, Torterra (Lv 82-83). Dark and Ghost moves for Lugia; Fire for Torterra.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Alpha Leader Pius, Peaks of Alpha)

milestones.name: Team Fusion: Regina (Peaks of Alpha)
milestones.tips: Regina's last stand: Zoroark, Ditto, Moltres, Banette, Roserade, Ho-Oh 83 (Lv 82-83). Rock moves for the birds; Ditto copies your lead, so lead with something it can't use well.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed (Regina, Peaks of Alpha)

milestones.name: Rival: Tye (Rankor)
milestones.tips: Tye, a trainer with all the Eevee forms, fights you around the isles (Nitro Isle, Alpha Isle, the stadium); the first is Vaporeon, Glaceon, Umbreon, Flareon, Leafeon, Jolteon (Lv 75-76) and the last Espeon, Glaceon, Leafeon, Flareon, Vaporeon, Jolteon (Lv 90-95).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Rival: Chelle (Olcan Isle)
milestones.tips: Chelle: Meganium, Kingdra, Garchomp, Absol, Skarmory, Tyranitar (Lv 73-75).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

milestones.name: Rankor Champion: Soul
milestones.tips: Four punches on the Rankor Ticket open the stadium and its champion Soul: Heracross, Houndoom, Gliscor, Roserade, Empoleon and 1 more (Lv 91-94). Expect a final rival round there first (Chelle at 87).
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts) (the stadium's section: not confirmed)

milestones.name: Trainer Isle: Rankor leaders rematch
milestones.tips: After the Rankor league, Trainer Isle offers the Rankor leaders again with Lv 90 sixes; Ricky adds Rayquaza and Makunouchi Deoxys.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); PokéHarbor ?p=1815 (Trainer Isle: Rankor Gym Leaders after the Rankor league)

milestones.name: Legendary trainer Red (Mt. Silver)
milestones.tips: Red at the top of Mt. Silver, reached from Johto's Victory Road: Pikachu, Lapras, Snorlax, Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise (Lv 100). Beating him gives the Ruby for Groudon.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts); PokeHostel

milestones.name: Soheal (Soheal's Strait)
milestones.tips: After the Tunod league, Soheal (Dragonite, Gliscor, Infernape, Espeon, Lucario, Victini (Lv 50)) guards the way to Mystery Island and the Mega Lucario quest: take the boat from Seaspray.
milestones.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Lugia (Whirl Islands)
milestones.tips: After Pius frees Lugia, a sailor on Route 40 takes a Diver to the sunken Whirl Islands. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Mewtwo (New Island)
milestones.tips: Dive at the Olivine dock to reach New Island; a Dragonite on Route 44 hints at it once you have seven Johto badges. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Mew (Fusion Labs)
milestones.tips: After the Tunod league, the top floor of the Fusion Labs; keep a party slot free. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Dialga (Adamant Cave)
milestones.tips: Level 50 in Adamant Cave in the Temporal Sea, with the Adamant Orb from the Fusion Resort penthouse quest.
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Giratina (Griseous Cave)
milestones.tips: Level 50 in Griseous Cave off the Haunted Seaway, with the Griseous Orb from the same quest.
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Palkia (Spacial Ruins)
milestones.tips: In the Spacial Ruins south of the Palmtree Resort. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Groudon, Kyogre, Rayquaza (Embedded Tower)
milestones.tips: Each needs its jewel: the Ruby from Red (Groudon, first floor), the Sapphire from the Slowpoke Well basement (Kyogre, bottom), the Emerald from Lance's Dragon's Den quest (Rayquaza, top; the hardest). (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Celebi (Ilex Forest)
milestones.tips: Ilex Forest's shrine after the Johto league. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Regirock, Regice, Registeel
milestones.tips: With Waterfall, surf near the Mt. Stratus / Geminite Village entrance to reach the Regi caves. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

milestones.name: Uxie, Mesprit, Azelf (Peaks of Alpha)
milestones.tips: A white stone at the Peaks of Alpha, after beating Soul. (No level found in the sources: the cap shown is a guess at the post-game level.)
milestones.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

steps.title: Pick one of five starters
steps.text: Professor Willow in Glenwood Town offers Turtwig, Chimchar, Piplup, Shinx and Riolu; the other four can be had later. A red-scarfed Pikachu is a forced fight soon after, so Piplup is the hardest start.

steps.title: Catch Ground or Grass types for Sparky
steps.text: Sparky's three Electric types fall to any Ground move; Turtwig or Riolu also do well. Train in Forest Pass and Springside Path.

steps.title: HMs follow the badges
steps.text: On the wiki's list the Tunod badges unlock Cut, (none), Rock Smash, Strength, Surf, Fly, Dive and Waterfall in that order.

steps.title: Tunod Safari Zone
steps.text: The Tunod Safari Zone off Path of Victory has rarer catches; Chelle waits there.

steps.title: Climb into Palmtree Resort
steps.text: Team Fusion runs its company from the Palmtree Resort; its labs come before the Rock gym in the same town.

steps.title: Level to the mid-50s for the Tunod league
steps.text: The four colour-themed members run 48-53 and Blake 57. The league is beyond Path of Victory and Victory Road.

steps.title: Johto opens after the Tunod Champion
steps.text: You land on Route 39 near Olivine; the Johto gyms are in the 57-72 range and their order differs from the original games (Falkner, Morty, Jasmine, Bugsy, Simon, Brian, Silver, Clair).
steps.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); nuzlocketracker.pages.dev/guides/glazed

steps.title: Rankor isles
steps.text: After the Johto league the isles between Tunod and Johto open: four leaders, a ticket instead of badges, and a stadium champion at the end.

steps.title: Pokédex from the Inventor
steps.text: Willow sends you to the Inventor in Chocco Town for the Pokédex, then you escort him through Milkshake Swamp. Lead with a spare Pokemon there: a Pineco explodes. Since 9.1 poison stops at 1 HP outside battle.
steps.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); emulatorhacks.com Glazed page (9.1 poison)

steps.title: Shipwrecked on Haunted Isle
steps.text: The boat to Serenity Isle crashes on Haunted Isle. Haunted Rock holds a Moon Stone, a Lantern and TM02 Dragon Claw before Michael waits at the end.

steps.title: Shards and Strength in Geminite
steps.text: Geminite Village trades fossils for shards and gives a Shovel to dig more; the Mt. Stratus foreman hands over Strength (HM04). 9.1 adds a Rock Slide tutor in the village.
steps.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); emulatorhacks.com Glazed page (9.1)

steps.title: Surf from Percy
steps.text: Percy gives you Surf around Northcoast Town, which opens the sea routes and the Icicle Tunnel side of the north.

steps.title: Fly from Blake at Temporal Tower
steps.text: Blake hands over Fly at Temporal Tower; Surfing into the Temporal Sea from Chocco Town was a known freeze in the betas, so fly there instead.

steps.title: Stamina Challenge in Southerly City
steps.text: The Stamina Challenge in Southerly City is a run of battles that pays well; the old guide used it to train to about Lv 55.

steps.title: Fusion Labs loot
steps.text: The Fusion Labs hold a Master Ball and a Timburr; Blake gives Dive there, and the labs are entered by diving.

steps.title: Waterfall from Percy
steps.text: Percy gives the Waterfall move in Darkwood Town; with it you can later reach the Regi caves off Mt. Stratus.
steps.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

steps.title: Rock Climb from Blake
steps.text: After the Core Badge, Blake teaches Rock Climb. Several post-league areas (Mt. Furnace, the Icicle Tunnel's secret part) need it.
steps.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); vizzed.com Legends of Glazed

steps.title: What the Tunod league opens
steps.text: Beating Blake opens Mew (top of the Fusion Labs, free party slot), Zekrom (Oceanview power plant roof), Reshiram (back of Mt. Furnace), Kyurem (Icicle Tunnel), Soheal's Victini, and Latios/Latias roaming Tunod.

steps.title: Johto starter and Badge Case
steps.text: Elm in New Bark Town offers a Johto starter and the Badge Case; Cherrygrove has a Mystic Water. Since 9.1 Bill waits in the first Johto town for the teleport system.
steps.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); emulatorhacks.com Glazed page (9.1 Bill)

steps.title: Jasmine's gym is interrupted
steps.text: Jasmine's fight in Olivine is cut short; she is freed in Whitewood City after the Church of Alpha and gives the Mineral Badge there.

steps.title: Whirlpool in Whitewood
steps.text: A man in Whitewood City gives Whirlpool; it works outside battle once you have Clair's badge.

steps.title: Ho-Oh and the beasts
steps.text: Regina takes Ho-Oh at the Bell Tower. Afterwards Entei, Raikou and Suicune can be met at the Bell Tower and then roam.
steps.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; vizzed.com Legends of Glazed

steps.title: Cianwood: Silver, Bridgette and the dojo
steps.text: Silver is found in the Cianwood dojo and returns to his gym when you talk to him. On Route 40 Bridgette's challenge (beat her five friends) gives a Lucky Egg.

steps.title: Evergreen surf race
steps.text: Win the surfing race in Evergreen Town for the Sea Jewel; it lets Manaphy appear in the Spatial Sea.
steps.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain)

steps.title: Seven badges: New Island
steps.text: With seven Johto badges, a Dragonite on Route 44 points you to New Island: dive at the Olivine dock and use the Blank CD to face the clones before Mewtwo.
steps.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

steps.title: Lance and the Ruins of Alph
steps.text: After the Johto league, Lance at the peak of Johto Victory Road starts the quest that leads to Heatran in Mt. Silver and to Red (the Ruby). The Ruins of Alph subquest opens the Sapphire (Slowpoke Well) and Emerald (Dragon's Den).
steps.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; vizzed.com Legends of Glazed

steps.title: Plumes for the birds
steps.text: Kyurem, Reshiram and Zekrom drop the Ice Plume, Fire Plume and Thunderplume; take them to Mt. Frozon (Articuno), Mt. Tritorch (Moltres) and Mt. Dyno (Zapdos).
steps.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

steps.title: Trainer Isle after the Rankor league
steps.text: Beating Soul opens Trainer Isle's Rankor Gym Leaders, Mixed Gym Leaders, Tough Doubles and Special Singles; its Power Shack sells type-boosting held items.

secrets.text: Mr. Pokémon on Route 30 gives a Togepi.
A house in Northcoast Town gives a Glaceon.
The adoption clinic in Stormy City gives a Grovyle.
The Oceanview bed and breakfast gives an Onix.
Eevee lives in Palmtree Park; one is also the prize of the lighthouse challenge.
The Northcoast museum revives the Dome Fossil (Kabuto) and the Old Amber (Aerodactyl).
A boathouse in Oceanview trades a Ninetales for a Poliwhirl; another Oceanview trade gives a Politoed.
A Violet City trade gives an Onix that evolves into Steelix.
Olivine trades a Slowpoke that becomes Slowking.
Reefen Isle trades a Scyther that becomes Scizor.
Dratini, Larvitar, Beldum, Bagon and Gible all appear on Forlorn Cape.
Tepig, Snivy and Oshawott are on Reefen Isle; Fennekin, Chespin and Froakie on Reign Isle.
Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle can be had in Goldenrod City.
Trainer Isle holds the Battle Tower, doubles and special battles, and leader rematches after the Rankor league.
After the Cresselia event, Darkrai waits at the VIP villa in the Palmtree Resort.
Ho-Oh can be met at Lv 76-77 late in the game (the wiki names Kolo Isle / Mt. Frozon and the Peaks of Alpha).
The legendary beasts are tied to the Brass Tower (the wiki warns of a glitch there).

secrets.text: Beat Soheal (six Lv 50s) past Seaspray Town and he gives you a Victini (Lv 20).
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: Finish the errands for the girl in the Fusion Resort for the Wish Ticket; the sailor at Oceanview harbour takes you to Wish Island (Jirachi Lv 15).
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: In Espo Forest (west of Southerly City, by Surf) take the left path and write THANK YOU at the shrine, then chase Shaymin (Lv 30).
At the fountain in Darkwood Town enter JUSTICE! and a cave opens with Keldeo (Lv 40).
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain)

secrets.text: Use Roar on the sleeping man outside Violet City and beat his Fearow for the Lunar Wing; trade it at the Azure Inn for a bed that leads to Dreamspace and Cresselia. Darkrai follows at the Palmtree VIP villa.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: With the Sea Jewel from the Evergreen surf race, Manaphy appears in the Spatial Sea; chase it as it dives.
secrets.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; vizzed.com Legends of Glazed

secrets.text: Once Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion have shown themselves at the Peaks of Alpha, the chamber through Darkwood Grotto opens: Virizion, Terrakion, then Cobalion.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: After the Tunod league, the back of Mt. Furnace (Rock Climb) holds Reshiram; it drops the Fire Plume.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: After the Tunod league, a lighter floor tile on the roof of Oceanview's power plant leads to Zekrom; it drops the Thunderplume.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: After the Tunod league, the secret part of Icicle Tunnel (Rock Climb) holds Kyurem; it drops the Ice Plume.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: The Blackwhite Ruins, reached through Mt. Mortar east of Ecruteak, fuse Kyurem: the black cave or the white cave; repeat in the same cave to undo.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: Lance's quest ends in the lava cave inside Mt. Silver (by the mine cart from Goldenrod's station) with Heatran.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: Articuno on Mt. Frozon (Kolo Isle), Zapdos on Mt. Dyno (Nitro Isle), Moltres on Mt. Tritorch (Olcan Isle), each after its plume.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

secrets.text: Once every other legendary has been met (the roamers excepted), the long route up Mt. Stratus to the cloud temple leads to Arceus.
secrets.source: vizzed.com Legends of Glazed; emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; Glazed fan wiki (search extract)

secrets.text: At the Peaks of Alpha, type NOT ALONE... on the ancient keyboard; a long cave of ladders and pitfalls leads to Deoxys. Bring Repels.

evolutions.source: ROM evolution and wild tables; Glazed fan wiki (Glaceon gift)

notes.title: Three regions
notes.text: Tunod is the main region (8 badges and its own league), then Johto (8 more badges in a new order and a second league), then the Rankor isles (4 leaders on a ticket and a champion).
notes.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

notes.title: Mega Evolution
notes.text: Late in the game: Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise, Lucario, Salamence, Absol, Manectric. A Mega here is permanent, learns nothing from TMs or tutors, and the Mega Stone works on all of them (Mega Stone X: Charizard only).
notes.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

notes.title: Fairy type and the split
notes.text: The physical/special split and the Fairy type are in, with the newer games' Fairy re-types.
notes.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

notes.title: Move Relearner
notes.text: The Move Relearner takes money instead of Heart Scales; an EV-training dojo exists.
notes.source: Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

notes.title: Glazed Unofficial 9.1
notes.text: A fan continuation of 8.6.3: Bill in the first Johto town, a Rock Slide tutor in Geminite Village, BW-style Repel, eggs hatch at Lv 1, 1.5x critical hits, shiny odds 1/4096, no vitamin cap, modern Sturdy. Gym levels are slightly lower than 8.6.3's in places.
notes.source: Glazed 9.1 change list (fan wiki); ROM trainer table

notes.title: Hidden Power's type
notes.text: Known bug: Hidden Power shows its type only after it is learned.
notes.source: Glazed 9.1 change list (fan wiki)

notes.title: Latios and Latias roam Tunod
notes.text: After the Tunod league they wander Tunod, changing place daily and staying around after being knocked out. Lars at the Legendary Research Lab near Violet City says where one is (one per day).
notes.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; vizzed.com Legends of Glazed

notes.title: The legendary beasts
notes.text: After Regina takes Ho-Oh, Entei, Raikou and Suicune appear at the Bell Tower and then roam. Arceus's requirement leaves them (and the Latis) out.
notes.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page; Glazed fan wiki (search extract)

notes.title: Trade Stone
notes.text: The ROM lets a Trade Stone do every trade evolution (Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler, Haunter, Onix, Scyther, Seadra, Slowpoke, Poliwhirl, Porygon, Gurdurr, and Rhydon, Electabuzz, Magmar, Porygon2, Feebas). Players report it as a Northcoast ski race prize and in the Goldenrod store.
notes.source: ROM evolution table; PokéCommunity Blazed Glazed thread, YouTube comments (where)

notes.title: Every starter
notes.text: Five Tunod starters from Willow (all five catchable later), a Johto one from Elm, Kanto ones in Goldenrod (Oak), Unova ones on Reefen Isle and Kalos ones on Reign Isle.
notes.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); PokéHarbor ?p=1815; Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

notes.title: Two worlds
notes.text: The story moves between the Pokemon world and the real world; the Pokédex holds Sinnoh, Unova and Kalos Pokemon in place of many Hoenn ones.
notes.source: PokéHarbor ?p=1815; ROM species table

notes.title: Trainer Isle teams in the ROM
notes.text: Besides the Rankor leaders (Lv 90), the ROM holds Lv 90 teams for all eight Johto leaders and Lv 100 teams for Lance, Steven, Wallace and Cynthia; the sources name Mixed Gym Leaders and Special Singles at Trainer Isle but not which is which.
notes.source: ROM glazed-unofficial trainer table (levels, teams); PokéHarbor ?p=1815

notes.title: More 9.1 changes
notes.text: Wild Wingull and Pelipper hold a Lucky Egg half the time; catching gives EXP; natures show their stats; underwater movement is twice as fast; late-game starters come at higher levels.
notes.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page (9.1 change list)

notes.title: 9.0 changes
notes.text: 9.0 (TrainerX493, Lucbui, Datudou) rebuilt every move pool from the newest games and gave important trainers the new moves; Lickitung, Tangela, Yanma and Piloswine evolve at set levels.
notes.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page (9.0 change list)

notes.text: No 9.2.0 change list was found. Every boss team this guide names is checked against the 9.2.0 ROM, and all of the 9.1 guide's fights are still there.
notes.source: ROM glazed-unofficial (9.2.0) trainer table

notes.title: Kyurem forms cost moves
notes.text: Fusing or splitting Kyurem keeps only its level: taught moves are lost and EVs reset.
notes.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

notes.title: HMs can be forgotten
notes.text: HM moves can be forgotten at any time, so a field-move slave is optional.
notes.source: emulatorhacks.com Glazed page (8.7 features carried into 9.x)

notes.title: Lucky Eggs
notes.text: Chansey in Palmtree Park and (since 9.1) Wingull and Pelipper carry Lucky Eggs; Bridgette on Route 40 gives one.
notes.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); emulatorhacks.com Glazed page

notes.title: In-game trades
notes.text: Oceanview: Ninetales and Politoed. Violet: Onix. Olivine: Slowpoke. Southerly: Kirlia for Ninetales. Blackthorn: Ampharos for Dragonair. Reefen Isle: Scyther. A Seadra trade gives Kingdra.
notes.source: vizzed.com Glazed Guide (Livid Pain); Glazed fan wiki (search extracts)

notes.title: Arceus's condition
notes.text: Arceus wants every other legendary encountered (battled, caught or fled), event ones included, but not Latios, Latias, Entei, Raikou or Suicune.
notes.source: Glazed fan wiki Legendary Pokémon Guide (search extract); vizzed.com Legends of Glazed
